Development of new prognostic and therapeutic tools in CLL

This research line is outlined by our double profile as a research/facility group. Concerning the development of prognostic markers in CLL, we previously described that the expression ratio of Lipoprotein Lipase (LPL) and metalloprotease ADAM29 is an important additional marker for the prognosis of CLL (Oppezzo et al, Blood, 2005).
